text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 04 · 壁炉旁的阅读角.
Environment:  A small English cottage reading alcove, wide low window looking onto snow, cream plaster and irregular light stone, worn exposed oak ceiling beam. An unlit small stone hearth, stacked firewood, deep cream linen armchair at left with a rumpled knitted throw, old wood bookcase and round tea table with one mug and open book with unrecognizable marks. Daylight is the dominant luminous illumination, not dark firelight. Camera from adjoining room, open central area, soft fabric texture. Intimate, comfortably lived in, not magazine-perfect.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic overhead CONCEPT PLAN. Depict footprint, connected zones, wall thickness, doors, windows, stairs, furniture footprints and circulation. For outdoors use a site plan of paths, terrain, bridges and water instead of domestic rooms. North is only design orientation. Compact labels; no invented metric dimensions. Flat diagram on white background.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 04 · 壁炉旁的阅读角. Create ONE clear TRUE FLAT 2D floor plan or outdoor site plan reconstructing this exact reference scene, for staging and spatial understanding. Show only this location and immediate footprint, not a whole unrelated complex. Preserve distinctive architecture, openings, landmarks and furniture positions. Infer unseen bounds conservatively, mark inferred extension dashed. Black technical lines on white, pale zone fills, wall thickness, door arcs, windows, furniture horizontal footprint symbols, outdoor paths/water/terrain where relevant. North arrow is conceptual sheet orientation. No perspective, no raised walls, no fake dimension/scale numbers, no people or animals. Small English zone labels, title CONCEPT PLAN, large uncluttered plan. Good proportions and connected walkable passages. Landscape format.
